title: Rug Yank
description: Every rug puller drops its rug when it dies; run over one and you yank it, and every bear on screen trips and sits stunned for 2 s.

title: Sell Wall
description: At 6:00 a wall of red sell orders sweeps across the screen from one edge: find the one gap and slip through, or take a big hit and get shoved back.

title: Stampede
description: Kills fill a green meter; when it's full, tap and a herd of green bulls thunders across the screen, trampling everything in its path.
